title: Retained test-failure and pilot-gate policy
approval_effect: No blanket acceptance of retained failures or errors; node-level classification required; baseline increase requires exact Founder approval.
pilot_gate_effect: Overall technical pilot gate; zero unresolved P0 before pilot and P1 treatment required before pilot.

title: Cross-barn task mutation and authorization model
approval_effect: Active context alone is insufficient; server-side execution-time reauthorization and tenant/barn predicates required.
pilot_gate_effect: Cross-barn mutation workflows blocked until errors resolved or excluded from pilot.

title: Notification delivery and failure policy
approval_effect: No untracked fire-and-forget coroutine delivery; durable delivery states and retries required.
pilot_gate_effect: Notification/digest claims blocked unless durable delivery is implemented or explicitly deferred.

title: Production storage failure policy
approval_effect: Production must never silently use local_dev_stub; upload/document features unavailable until storage verified.
pilot_gate_effect: Signed-document custody and upload features blocked until production storage is verified.

title: Background-job leadership and duplicate-execution model
approval_effect: Web replicas must not independently execute duplicate recurring schedules; job leadership observable.
pilot_gate_effect: Pilot-visible scheduled jobs blocked unless leadership and duplicate controls are verified.

title: Offline product posture and controlled native pilot distribution
approval_effect: Online-first pilot; limited actor/context/barn-bound field recovery; controlled private native beta distribution may be prepared.
pilot_gate_effect: Full offline support remains unauthorized; native beta preparation does not authorize pilot enrollment.

title: Production-ready legal electronic-signature capability
approval_effect: Production-ready DocuSign capability is mandatory before pilot; provider-neutral legal e-signature adapter required.
pilot_gate_effect: Mandatory pilot gate; no pilot enrollment until readiness package and exact Founder activation approval.

title: Controlled pilot delivery channel
approval_effect: Controlled pilot may use web/PWA/TestFlight/Google internal or closed testing after channel-specific gates.
pilot_gate_effect: Public app-store release unauthorized; tester enrollment and pilot enrollment separately blocked.
